steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Tsk, tsk.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We got here too late. They finished their fight and now there's no one alive to talk to.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: You stopped our duel just to watch a boring shootout?
Woman and wolf stand on the barrenlands as the sun rises, with a yellow cab parked not far from them.
The cab's hood bears a deep depression from a prior intimate meeting with a boulder. Tire tracks twist and turn in its wake peppered with strewn up dirt, narrating the car's journey here...
Several bodies lie around the car. The wind carries the stench of blood far away, inciting low growls from wild beasts in the distance.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Zaaro, there are two things you ought to understand.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: One: I am not a toy for your entertainment. Two: As my toy for my entertainment, I've realized an immortal Signore dei Lupi is just so boring...

spans.text: One: I am not a toy for your entertainment. Two: As
entertainment, I've realized an immortal Signore dei Lupi is just so boring...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Compared to you, isn't a famiglia shoot out happening in the middle of the wastes much more interesting?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, the car can still move even after all that?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Where was its original destination?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Let's see... a spot circled on the map—'Nuova Volsinii', and some entry documents in the glove box to boot... Looks like we're all set!

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: A familiar name.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hey, Zaaro. Help me drag these corpses aside so I can reverse the car.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: You want to...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Siracusa has graced us with an invitation.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Don't tell me you'd refuse? I didn't think a Signore dei Lupi would be so rude.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I told you, I will walk with you until the victor is decided.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Then help me out!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Salve.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: Um, y-you don't have to be so formal, Signor Capone.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Relax. I just didn't wanna spook you with this scary mug of mine. After all, it wasn't easy to secure this meet-up with you.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: I thought a lot about your proposal. If city hall staff discover I privately transferred my citizen points to you, will they...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Just pick a few documents from your pile of certs, write a little explanation, and change the name on 'em. Simple.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'll earn fifty points, while you get... a lotta dough.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: We ain't violatin' no laws here. If city hall got a problem, it just means the New Urban Management Act needs more revisions. I bet you know this better than me.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: When you put it like that...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Identity registration's awful unfair, ain't it?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I turned over a new leaf, paid so much guarantee money the past six months and did so much community service all thanks to my criminal record. All that work, and I still haven't earned even half of the 120 points I need...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But you? A 'clean resume', and 'experience in law-adjacent tech industries'... You're pretty new here, but the points you converted from all that's already enough to become a citizen three times over!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It'd be a waste to keep 'em for yourself.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: I applied for an appointment next week to get my documents authenticated. I'll get these revisions done before that—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Easy, pal.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: Huh? Aren't you the one wanting to become a citizen ASAP?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: What I mean is, have you ever thought of puttin' off your citizenship application?

spans.text: ever thought of puttin' off your citizenship application?

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: Wh-What do you mean?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Lots of us guys in the city could use a lot more points, but there ain't many guys like you who can get 'em so easy. So...

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm happy to play middleman.

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: Nuova Volsinii introduced the New Urban Management Act to deter people like you—S-Sorry...

steps.name: Nervous Passerby
steps.text: I mean, aren't we contradicting the city's founding principles by doing this?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: C'mon, pal. Relax, relaaax. I was just thinkin' out loud, is all. Don't mind me.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: But noodle on it a bit. Why'd you come here? A stable income? A better life?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You think you'll get that after you become a legal citizen of Nuova Volsinii and work an entry-level job at a law firm?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: (Claps)

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Are you going to stay here and watch them all night, Lappland?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Why the rush? How can we start our night shift before getting some food? Want a slice of this freshly baked polenta?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: On second thought, let's not waste it.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: You're in a good mood... Just because you witnessed that strange deal happen?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Zaaro, how long have we been here in Nuova Volsinii?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: More than two months.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: And how many places have we been, in that span of time? How many customers have we ferried?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Isn't it uncomfortable, seeing everyone in the city act so prim and proper?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The city hall staff and court judges are itching to slap their laws on their foreheads, ready to fight against Siracusa's old customs and rules at any moment...

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: While the famiglie are trying their best to prove how much they like and have adapted to this new set of game rules.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I've never seen Siracusans this restrained, this uncomfortable, like everyone has a mask sewn onto their faces.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: It'll be Carnevale soon. Are they even in the mood to enjoy the so-called 'carnival'?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm thankful for our two friends here worrying over their citizen points for showing me Siracusa remains the same, and it's in every Siracusan's nature to turn every new territory into a swamp.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Haha, now I'm looking forward to Carnevale.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Hey, are you even listening?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I smelled their scent.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Your compatriots, the other Signori dei Lupi?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: No plans to catch up with them?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: A Signore dei Lupi who has left the game should no longer interfere.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Don't look so defeated, Zaaro. You did lose, but it doesn't mean you can't derive any more fun from it.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Think about it, what else can you do?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Free yourself. We returned to this swamp for a leisurely swim.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: And you? When are you planning to say hello to your past?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Carissimo padre mio, you mean?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I already said addio... though I did prepare a gift for him this time.

spans.text: I already said addio... though I
prepare a gift for him this time.

steps.text: The cab driver stops talking, and lifts her legs onto the dashboard to rest in a more comfortable position.

Through the car window ahead is a wall sporting a huge billboard advertising a winery. A sullen-looking man with his tightly-knit brows brandishes a wine glass towards the camera, with the following invitation—
'Saluzzo Vino is looking for a senior legal advisor! Several other positions also open, apply to join us today!'

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: Don Alberto, we got all the information here. Please have a look.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: We have a total of thirteen wineries in this city. Six of them are undergoing a qualification audit and cannot operate for the time being.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: Two of them on the city's outer plates are about to welcome their first harvest, and the warehouse, lab, and bottling line are ready...

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: But there's no way we can handle this many ripened grapes in this short period of time with half our wineries not operating.

steps.name: Famiglia Lawyer
steps.text: The root of our problem lies with city hall's attitude towards us, those stronzi are obviously targeting us on purpose—

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: These files are meant for our friend here. He has the means of solving such problems.
Alberto looks across the table, where a red-headed Lupo has been sitting for a while.
The wine is finally decanted, and he takes a sip, calmly returning Alberto's gaze.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Merge and restructure all Saluzzo properties in this city into new entities, including both the operating ones and those undergoing an audit...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Then, hire non-stakeholder employees to manage on-site operations. This is feasible under the New Urban Management Act.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Simply put, I will transfer these properties to you.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Famiglia Bellone does not have large-scale businesses, so the procedure should be relatively simple. Yet you've been rejected more than ten times now.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Whenever it involves a 'Bellone' or 'Saluzzo', the government and court—or should I say, Leontuzzo and Lavinia—always tend to react in a more defensive manner.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: It sounds like I have no reason to refuse this arrangement.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Demetri, what I value more is that you understand Leontuzzo better than anyone else, as well as the rules he has set—

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: You are the best fit for this position.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I want to see if city hall will still brazenly clamp down on us even after we tie our companies together in total compliance with the New Urban Management Act.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Don't you agree, our new Don Bellone?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Don't treat me like your puppet, Alberto.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I admit Bellone's company registration has met many bumps on the road, and your invitation was timely.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You get rid of some troubles, while I gain the rights to legally enter the city. We're just business partners getting what we want.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Even though the Bellones are not what they used to be in Siracusa anymore; even though this new city doesn't have famiglie anymore, you need to know this—

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: My choice to work for Saluzzo Vino does not in any way mean the Bellones will be at the Saluzzos' beck and call.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: So you'd best put that title to rest. I'm not sitting here as the don of Famiglia Bellone.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: There's no point in acting tough, ragazzo.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Whether or not this collaboration will mean 'The Bellones have thrown themselves at the Saluzzos'—I'm curious how Leontuzzo will see it.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: Oh, almost forgot. Maybe he doesn't even care at all anymore.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: He already abandoned you.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: If you insist on this topic... Aren't you a lone wolf too, Alberto?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: The White Wolf of Saluzzo—your daughter—who always disobeyed your orders, has left her famiglia forever.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: According to my sources, she arrived in Nuova Volsinii a few months ago... as a cab driver.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I'm curious, too. Did she come here to add insult to your injury, or will she return home and help the Saluzzos?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: ...Lappland?

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I banished her.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: From what I know about her, she's probably thinking that's not how it went down.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: I won't take offense from you, Demetri, you are different from Bernardo, you understand what's going on.

steps.name: Alberto
steps.text: These harmless differences will not affect our shared interests, so why not take this as a happy start to our collaboration?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Fine, I won't waste my breath then.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Why not you sign this equity document first, Signor Alberto.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I'll use the dividends from this month to get Leon to reminisce about the good old days.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Went looking for your fellow floating heads?

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I did. A hypocritical and sly wolf.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Caesar has turned her Fang into an idiot who only knows how to bite people and suck blood. She won't be able to find Vargo's Fang even if she sniffed every single corner of this land.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: That Fang has never showed himself. Hidden very well.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: But if we had Bernardo here, locating a Siracusan in Siracusa would be like going through a pile of hay for an animal. Simple.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: If I don't interfere and help them out, god knows how long they're going to drag this round for!

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Zaaro, it's rare to see so many words spill out from your mouth.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: You're upsetting the table, and relishing it.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Like you are.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Esatto. Stop worrying about winning or losing, learn to do it for the love of the game, and derive even more enjoyment from it. That's what games are really for.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: How do you wolves fail to even understand this...?
Nuova Volsinii nights are dark.
Woman and wolf stand atop a building, sandwiched by the night sky above and the noisy city below—
Pre-Carnevale activities happen in all sorts of shades and forms, vehicles speed through the streets, pedestrians shuttle to and fro. They enjoy a panoramic view of everything happening below.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: They cover their fangs with masks, and use a festival to divulge their thirst to have it all. How sad.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: On the contrary, you seem to be enjoying this farce. When did you become so interested in such boring activities?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Zitto, Zaaro. You're noisier than the people who used to hang around me before.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: I'm just enjoying the breeze.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: We practically have a VIP seat here. So keep quiet and wait for the show to begin.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The actors are already on the stage...

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: You're late, Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: I'm sorry, it's been a really busy day.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Still working on your inaugural speech?

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Well, that too... We're planning a birthday party for an entire city. It's not quite the same as planning a party at home, is it?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: I'm surprised... you still remember.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Of course I do. Did you think I was going to forget how you bought ginger ale instead of beer for the banquet, and pocketed the difference to buy a car?

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Well, I guess that DID happen.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: You sound... distracted, Demetri.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Do I? It's nothing. I guess it's been too long since we last saw each other.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Take care on your way, Leon.

steps.name: Leontuzzo
steps.text: Might have taken that as a threat, if we weren't in Nuova Volsinii.

steps.name: Demetri
steps.text: Enough joking and hurry up. I'm waiting at the seat by the window.
The car drives by the apprentice tailor jogging on the street and heads to the end of the main street.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: I should pick up the pace. I can't miss the delivery window to hand over the clothes to Signor Alberto.

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: The Don of Famiglia Saluzzo...

steps.name: Luchino
steps.text: What kind of man is he?
Luchino gasps for breath with the suit in his arms as he runs through a deserted alley, illuminated only by the light coming from a cafe.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: That's the fifth slice of pizza and third glass of juice that you just eliminated. Are you that hungry?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Shut up and drink this espresso.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: It's so damn sour!

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: If we screw up this mission because this swill makes me throw up, whose head am I gonna give the boss, yours?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Live with it. I just picked it up off the shelf.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Nobody uses this frontage road anyway. Besides, it's just transporting a bunch of 'tires', what could go wrong?

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: No need to get all worked up about an unimportant job like this.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm tired of listening to your complaints for the past two months, Gambino.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Haven't you figured out our new boss yet? Trying too hard to show off in front of him will only have the opposite effect.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Fresh meat like us, we gotta be patient and wait for our chance.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Well, ain't you the model employee, Capone.

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: I thought you would at least show a little bit of, I don't know, shame? There's hardly any place for a Sicilian in Siracusa these days.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I'm not Sicilian anymore. It's your shame, not mine.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: I just want to get my Nuova Volsinii citizenship sooner rather than later. All the work I put in over the past six months, all the guarantee money I paid, and I'm only halfway to the required points—

steps.name: Gambino
steps.text: Halfway?! You've got fifty more points than I do? Have you been doing—*gasp*—community service while I wasn't looking?

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Shut your crap, Gambino. We're on our last chance and you know it.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Keep your eyes sharp on the street. It should be coming any time now—

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: You got any pizza left? Give me one.

steps.name: Capone
steps.text: Cazzo, it's cold, how do you even manage to eat this...
As the two grumble to the other, a dark shadow quietly slips through the alley.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: *sniff*

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: This is the smell. True wolf.
A truck drives past Red and attracts her attention.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Are you hiding inside?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: *sniff*

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: No. Hm, over there?
She looks toward the opposite end of the street.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Grandma, I am a wolf hunter. I remember.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: The girls?

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: Vargo, I hope you left me accurate instructions on how to identify them.

steps.name: Ingrid
steps.text: *sigh*... It'll be a headache if I hurt the wrong people.
With blade in hand, the Vulpo leans on a wall hidden within its shadow, waiting in silence for the prime opportunity to strike.
She will eliminate the two targets who threaten Umberto's life in one go, and then demand her reward from the wolf.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Tsk. A kid loitering around the streets outside this late?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: (That figure... was I just seeing things?)

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Lyudmila, Lyudmila... why did you space out so suddenly?

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: It's nothing... Just a little tired.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: You'd better get off and wait at that intersection coming up. We're about to arrive, and there'll be trouble with the Venezias if I show up with a rando in tow.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Lyudmila...

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: Enough. I got on your truck, so I'll stick with you all the way.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Thanks, Lyudmila.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: No matter what happens, I'm lucky to have you with me.

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Hmmhmm♪ Hmmhmmhmm♪ Hmm♪

steps.name: Lyudmila
steps.text: You've been listening to this song on loop for a while now. Not tired of it?

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: Of course!

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: 'A Chance Encounter' is an amazing song, and Sora's got one hell of a singing voice!

steps.name: Sommer
steps.text: It's the hottest new single this week. There was an interview saying she recorded it just for Carnevale.
Sommer hums to the song looping from the speakers.
Soon, the truck will reach the turning point ahead and bump into the other car.
Carnevale's curtains are slowly pulled open.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: In just one city block, we have our young and promising Acting Mayor, Fangs, people coming home for the festivities, and Sicilians too—I don't even know who they're seeking protection from...what a crowd.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: I could make it even noisier.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Just wait, Zaaro. You don't have to do anything.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Pretend you're a cab driver who turns on the radio at the right time to tune into a story.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: The games humanity plays are much more interesting than your kind's preference to select just a few people to fight each other.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Caesar's pup has discovered Agnese's cub.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Look! Isn't there another car coming from the port?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: —'Bang!'
The truck crashes into the car, and flees in a panic. Eye-watering flames, hysterical crowds.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Those who share the same stage, obviously perform the same play.

steps.name: Zaaro
steps.text: Just a chaotic show. I don't see what's so fun about this, Lappland.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: What's with the rush?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Before the play truly begins, allow me to perform my duty as an upstanding citizen of the city.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Pronto. Buonasera, is this the police?

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Me? Just a driver-for-hire. I'd like to make a report.

steps.name: Lappland
steps.text: Si... the port district. That's right, an accident just happened.
